# Scott Tupper
## Scott Tupper
### Tenure
1995 – 2000s
**Scott Irvin Tupper** is a former Mattel designer who worked for Hot Wheels until at least the 1990s. He managed the Pro Racing Line of Hot Wheels cars and acted as a designer for that line. Tupper currently owns and runs Wicked Concepts, a vehicle restoration shop based in California.
